violations.description: Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not properly protected from potential contamination. -Items in left upright freezer were uncovered. Fan was very frosted up.
Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution between uses. -Sitting on prep counter.

General equipment and utensils - Materials and design. — --Material of food contact surface was not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent and cleanable. -Need to repaint/repair rice cooking table.--Material of nonfood contact surface was not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent and cleanable. -Paint inside drawers, board above prep table, shelving under glass storage, under soda dispenser. -Remove cardboard from bottom shelf of back prep table.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Ventilation hood system was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. -Clean filters on grill hood.
Manual cleaning and sanitizing requirements. — --Pots were sitting in mop sink to be cleaned.
Plumbing system. — --Plumbing system was not designed, constructed, operated and/or maintained according to regulation. -Handwash sink was at 130F. Adjust so it is between 110F-120F.
Toilet facilities. — --Men's toilet room was not provided with sufficient mechanical ventilation.

Design and construction of floors, walls, and ceilings. — --Floors, walls, and/or ceiling were not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable. -Remove carpet from soda storage area. -Replace ceiling tiles throughout kitchen, prep and food storage with cleanable smooth tiles.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. -Need more thorough cleaning including in walk in cooler and grill area.--Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. -Floor tiles in kitchen have tears and need repairs.

Storage and handling of maintenance items. — --Wet-use maintenance items, such as mops, were not placed in a position that allows proper air-drying. -2 wet mops stored in mop buckets. Store in strainer of bucket or hang up in mop sink.
